episodes.name: Whiskey Tango Foxtrot
episodes.overview: An explosion at a D.C. event that results in a casualty connected to the agency changes Parsons’ perspective on Gibbs and the NCIS team.

episodes.name: Past, Present, and Future
episodes.overview: Determined to locate Ziva, Tony chases leads in Israel in search of her current whereabouts. Meanwhile, Gibbs and the team continue the hunt for Parsa and his growing terrorist ring.

episodes.name: Under the Radar
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must rely on Twitter for a case involving a missing Navy Lieutenant.

episodes.name: Anonymous Was a Woman
episodes.overview: Gibbs and McGee travel to Afghanistan when a murder case leads them to an Afghan women’s shelter that Mike Frank secretly supported for years.

episodes.name: Once a Crook
episodes.overview: DiNozzo returns to his Baltimore Police Department days when he sees a felony suspect from a 15-year-old case at the NCIS crime scene of a murdered Petty Officer.

episodes.name: Oil & Water
episodes.overview: The Coast Guard Investigative Service works with the NCIS team when an explosion occurs on an oil rig.

episodes.name: Better Angels
episodes.overview: After Gibbs leaves mid-case to help his father reconnect with a former war pilot, Tony and McGee argue over who should run lead on the team’s investigation into the murder of a Marine Sergeant.

episodes.name: Alibi
episodes.overview: The team is forced to take another look at a hit-and-run murder case.

episodes.name: Gut Check
episodes.overview: After discovering the Secretary of the Navy was bugged during a confidential briefing, NSA Analyst Eleanor Bishop, who predicted the security breach in exact detail two years ago, partners with the NCIS team on the case.

episodes.name: Devil’s Triad
episodes.overview: Complications arise when the NCIS team discovers a link between a murder victim and the current boyfriend of Gibbs and Agent Fornell’s ex-wife.

episodes.name: Homesick
episodes.overview: After a mysterious illness strikes children from military families, Gibbs and the team investigate the cause. Abby and Jimmy partner with the Naval Medical Research Center to determine the strain of illness, all in hopes of delivering a cure before the holidays.

episodes.name: Kill Chain
episodes.overview: When a stolen drone is linked to the elusive terrorist Parsa, the NCIS team partners with the Department of Defense, including Gibb’s former girlfriend Hollis Mann, to track down the device before it is used for a large scale attack.

episodes.name: Double Back
episodes.overview: In an effort to find the terrorist Parsa, Gibbs and the NCIS team track down one of his cohorts using evidence from the drone attack.

episodes.name: Monsters and Men
episodes.overview: A port authority officer's murder reveals a possible location for Parsa, while Bishop reveals a past connection to the terrorist.

episodes.name: Bulletproof
episodes.overview: After uncovering faulty bulletproof vests in a truck filled with stolen U.S.M.C. merchandise, the NCIS team attempts to locate both the source and any vests that had been shipped to military personnel overseas.

episodes.name: Dressed to Kill
episodes.overview: Someone winds up dead when DiNozzo confronts a man impersonating a Navy officer.

episodes.name: Rock and a Hard Place
episodes.overview: After a bomb detonates in the dressing room at a military charity concert, the NCIS team must determine if the target was a washed-up 1980s rocker or if the bomb was part of a larger scheme.

episodes.name: Crescent City (1)
episodes.overview: When a former NCIS agent's body washes ashore in New Orleans, Gibbs reunites with NCIS Special Agent Dwayne Cassius Pride to determine if the murder was politically motivated or related to a well-known case.

episodes.name: Crescent City (2)
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Special Agent Pride chase leads in New Orleans after evidence points to a copycat of the infamous Privileged Killer. DiNozzo, McGee, and the FBI continue to track political connections to the case from D.C.

episodes.name: Page Not Found
episodes.overview: After returning to her job at the Department of Defense, McGee’s girlfriend Delilah finds a break in a controversial case, prompting her to turn to the NCIS team for help.

episodes.name: Alleged
episodes.overview: After a Navy officer is found dead on a rural road, the NCIS team must ascertain if his death was the result of a bar fight or because he knew too much about an attack on a fellow female officer.

episodes.name: Shooter
episodes.overview: When a Marine photographer disappears prior to providing his testimony in an Army court-martial hearing, the NCIS team investigates both the murder he witnessed, as well as his current piece on military veterans who are homeless in the D.C. area.

episodes.name: The Admiral's Daughter
episodes.overview: Director Vance gives DiNozzo a special assignment to bring home an Admiral’s daughter from Paris, but he must turn to his NCIS team for help after he enters a controversial crime scene.

episodes.name: Honor Thy Father
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates whether a fire on a U.S. Navy ship that served as a secret detention site for indicted terrorists was accidental or an intentional diversion for an escape.
